project.name: ZENITH
project.description: ZENITH is the naming layer for HACD: a usage-first Stack Token that gates a live engine for scoring and discovering premium HACD names across the 16,777,216-name space.

asset.utility_summary: ZEN is the access key to the ZENITH naming engine. Holding ZEN unlocks tiered access: holders (>=1,000 ZEN) get premium name search and the namescore leaderboard; pro holders (>=10,000 ZEN) get bulk scoring and exports. All utility is live at launch; the engine works today.

copy.headline: Every HACD is a word. ZENITH tells you which words are worth owning.
copy.subheadline: ZENITH issues ZEN — a usage-first Stack Asset that gates a live engine for scoring and discovering premium HACD names.
copy.short_description: ZEN is formed across 256 HACD lots at 50 HAC each, 65,536 ZEN per lot, for a fixed total supply of 16,777,216 ZEN — one ZEN for every possible HACD name. No inflation. No hidden allocation. Formed on-chain.
copy.risk_disclosure: ZEN is a utility Stack Asset, not an investment product. No price, liquidity, listing, or return is guaranteed. Formation cost is non-refundable. Tiered access utility is live at launch; future features depend on development. This is a draft structure pending HACD Labs review. This is not financial advice.

notes: Generated with the HACD Incubator AI Issuance Skill and refined against live ecosystem research.
Total supply 16,777,216 is deliberately equal to the total HACD name space (16^6).
Genesis mirrors a reserved-first sequence: 32 reserved lots complete first, then 224 public lots open.
Reserved 32 lots = 2,097,152 ZEN (12.5%): used for ecosystem grants, engine operating costs, future development. Designated address will be public on-chain before public phase opens.
Public 224 lots = 14,680,064 ZEN (87.5%): open participation, 1-10 HACD per participant cap.
Access tiers (holder >=1,000 / pro >=10,000 ZEN) are enforced by the ZENITH backend and must be reflected at Launchpad level.
Maximum 10 HACD per participant must be enforced at Launchpad level.
All parameters are draft. Issuer confirmation and HACD Labs review required before Launchpad publication.
